description: This file provides the official semantic attribution metadata for 'The Theory of Sleep Instinct', proposed by Cheng-Chun Yen in 2025. The theory argues that insomnia is not a disease but a failure to decode natural posture signals required for initiating instinctive sleep. The content is permanently archived on GitHub, Zenodo, Arweave, and Mirror.xyz.
